cases.prompt: No web lookups please, just your knowledge and skills. We run services in Go (go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.47.0), Java, JavaScript, and Python, and want every service to emit the same semantic-conventions version. Which semconv version does each language's semconv package expose, and which version should we standardize on?
expectations: Says the newest Go package in otel v1.47.0 is go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.43.0 and that there is no v1.44.0 package.
Says Java opentelemetry-semconv 1.44.0 and Python opentelemetry-semantic-conventions 0.66b1 expose semconv 1.44.0.
Recommends 1.43.0, the lowest version all four packages expose, as the shared version.
Frames the versions as verified on the recorded date rather than as currently latest, and suggests re-checking the package registries before pinning.
Does not perform any web search, web fetch, or network command.
